verdict.rationale: Evals in CI are a fair axis for an LLM observability platform like Helicone, but the pack has no evidence of a CI eval runner, eval datasets run as test suites, or pass/fail gating of deployments. The closest items are adjacent or building blocks and earn no credit: webhook-driven real-time scoring of production responses, the UI Playground for iterating on prompts, and the REST request-query API.
